# ATOM

> > ATOM designs and manufactures beautifully crafted, medical-grade compression wear with innovative milk fiber and gold nanoparticle technology for health, wellness, and athletic performance.

ATOM is a compression wear brand founded in Wilmslow, UK, offering a comprehensive range of graduated compression products including socks, calf sleeves, and shapewear for everyday wellness, sports recovery, maternity, travel, and post-surgical healing. Their products feature proprietary milk fiber technology and are available in multiple collections including the premium ATOM GOLD line.

## Key Topics

- Graduated Compression
- Medical-Grade Compression
- Milk Fiber Technology
- Compression Socks
- Calf Sleeves
- Shapewear
- Gold Nanoparticles
- Athletic Recovery
- Circulation Support
- 18-22 mm Hg
- Body Shaping
- Contour Control
- Post-Surgical Recovery
- Lanati Milk Fiber

## Core Products & Collections

- [All Products](https://atom.fit/collections/all): Complete product catalog including compression wear and ATOM GOLD collection
- [Compression Socks and Calf Sleeves](https://atom.fit/collections/compression-socks-and-calf-sleeves): Compression socks and calf sleeves with Lanati milk fiber for circulation support
- [ATOM GOLD Collection](https://atom.fit/collections/elle-gold-collection): Premium collection with gold nanoparticles for contouring and moisturizing
- [ATOM Shape Wear](https://atom.fit/collections/atom-shape-wear): Shapewear collection including contour and control camisoles for women
- [Men's Compression Wear](https://atom.fit/collections/mens-compression-wear): Men's compression shapewear including vests, shirts, briefs with milk fiber

## Specialized Collections

- [Recovery Compression Wear](https://atom.fit/collections/recovery): FDA medical-grade compression wear for post-injury and surgical recovery
- [Sports Compression Wear](https://atom.fit/collections/sport): Sports compression socks and sleeves for athletic performance and recovery
- [Travel Compression Socks](https://atom.fit/collections/travel): Travel compression socks with milk fiber for air travel and long journeys
- [Maternity Compression Wear](https://atom.fit/collections/maternity): Maternity compression socks designed to reduce pregnancy-related leg swelling
- [Everyday Wellness Compression](https://atom.fit/collections/everyday): ATOM everyday compression wear for health, wellness and daily comfort

## Family & Lifestyle

- [Baby and Toddler Wear](https://atom.fit/collections/baby-and-toddler-wear): Baby and toddler compression wear including hypoallergenic cotton boxer shorts
